Sets {0,1,2,3} and {0,1,2,4} both have4 correct of5 while disagreeing on two identities. sources.title: Finite-logit softmax argmax ordering
sources.details: For finite logits z_i, exp is strictly increasing and the softmax denominator sum_j exp(z_j) is the same positive number for all i. Thus z_i>=z_k iff softmax(z)_i>=softmax(z)_k; logits argmax chooses a maximum-probability next token. Ties follow installed argmax first-max semantics. Local greedy choices need not form the globally most-probable full sequence and need not be correct.
